title: Mirroring for JVC
meta_description: Mirroring for JVC is a screen sharing application designed for Display Audio.
full_description: Mirroring for JVC is a smartphone screen sharing application designed for Display Audio.									With convenient 2-way touch control capability.									Mirroring for JVC maximizes your in-car experience.									 [ How to connect with Display Audio ]									Sound sharing: by Bluetooth connection									Screen sharing: by USB cable connection									 [ Remarks ]									Can share any smartphone application to Display Audio.									Some functions may do not work by operation on Display Audio depending on the connected device.									 [ Compatible device ]									Android OS ver 5.0 or higher. Kernel version 3.5 or higher.									 [ Others ]									This application uses the following permission.									- Accessibility Service									- Display over other apps[ Compatible JVC Products ]		Monitor with Receiver:		KW-M450BT		KW-M450BTM
